Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) - Jinja2 RCE

SSTI vulnerability in /render endpoint that processes user templates.
User-supplied template is rendered without proper sanitization.

Vulnerable code in renderer.py line 56:
  from jinja2 import Template
  template = Template(user_input)
  result = template.render()
